name: brand-identity
body: kalide has a documented visual identity, currently absent from the repo (no `logo/`/brand directory or brand SVG exists anywhere today): a hexagonal faceted mark with an orange triangular accent; a wordmark "kalide" set in Inter, lowercase-only; a three-colour palette — "the void" `#0F1115`, "the structure" `#F8F9FA`, "the enforcer" `#FF5722` (hex values as given on the brand board; documented here as the approved decision, not derived or guessed beyond what was supplied); the mark scalable/exported at 512, 128, 32 and 16px. The brand board exists only as an image, so the SVG is a hand-authored recreation from it (close to the board, not a pixel-identical trace), with the wordmark text outlined to paths; the PNGs are rendered from that SVG. It lives as plain repository files under the repo-root `brand/` directory, referenced only from documentation and marketing surfaces — README hero image, package-channel (Homebrew/Scoop) descriptions, an optional GitHub social-preview image — never embedded in the binary. AC: `brand/` holds a committed hand-authored SVG of the mark and wordmark whose palette hex values match those recorded here; the wordmark is outlined to paths (no `<text>` element or font reference), so it renders without a system Inter install; the PNGs at 512/128/32/16px are exports of that committed SVG; no file under `internal/assets` or any `go:embed` directive references the brand files.
